manaNeeded: {3}{U} and {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Glorious Protector must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying {3}{U}.
When Phantom Steed enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Glorious Protector to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Phantom Steed until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Abdel Adrian to return from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Glorious Protector and any number of other nonland permanents you control until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating at least one 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, ending its effect, causing Phantom Steed to return from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
